query: WITH target(table_name) AS (VALUES ('users'),('dashboard_report_schedules'),('audit_logs'),('webhook_deliveries'),('schema_drift_monitors'),('schema_drift_runs'),('tra_z_report_archive_schedules'),('tra_z_report_archives'),('tra_gateway_alert_settings'),('tra_gateway_alert_events'),('tra_vat_anomaly_settings'),('tra_vat_anomaly_events'),('bank_market_rates'),('dse_market_tickers'),('market_provider_settings'),('market_provider_uptime_logs'),('market_provider_incidents')) SELECT t.table_name, c.relrowsecurity AS rls_enabled, (SELECT count(*) FROM information_schema.columns ic WHERE ic.table_schema='public' AND ic.table_name=t.table_name) AS column_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint pc WHERE pc.conrelid=c.oid AND pc.contype='p') AS primary_key_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_constraint pc WHERE pc.conrelid=c.oid AND pc.contype='f') AS foreign_key_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_indexes pi WHERE pi.schemaname='public' AND pi.tablename=t.table_name) AS index_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies pp WHERE pp.schemaname='public' AND pp.tablename=t.table_name) AS policy_count, (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_policies pp WHERE pp.schemaname='public' AND pp.tablename=t.table_name AND pp.cmd='ALL') AS all_command_policy_count FROM target t JOIN pg_class c ON c.relname=t.table_name JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace AND n.nspname='public' ORDER BY t.table_name LIMIT 50;
